title: Lead Scout - Americas
description:
Be Part of a Legacy Bigger Than the Game


At Al-Qadsiah Club we’re creating more than teams—we’re crafting a legacy that goes beyond the game, making an impact both on and off the field. Driven by ambition, synergy, and innovation, we aim to inspire generations while shaping the future of Saudi sports.


This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.



Overview:


As the Americas Lead Scout at Al-Qadsiah Club, you will be responsible for managing scouting operations within a designated region. You will identify and evaluate first-team and emerging talent, ensuring all scouting aligns with the club’s methodology, recruitment strategy, and long-term objectives. You will also support academy integration and contribute to collaborative recruitment planning.



Key Responsibilities:


Leadership and Management

  • Lead and manage the scouting team for your designated region
  • Ensure scouts follow the established methodology and framework
  • Provide ongoing support and development for regional scouts


Scouting Strategy and Alignment

  • Operate within the club's recruitment methodology and strategic objectives
  • Conduct regular reviews to ensure alignment with scouting targets and expectations


Player Evaluation and Reporting

  • Attend live and online matches to evaluate player performance
  • Conduct in-depth research on leagues and players as directed
  • Produce detailed and structured reports using club templates
  • Present findings and support informed recruitment decisions


Networking and Relationship Building

  • Build a regional network with clubs, agents, and fellow scouts
  • Gather insights on player availability, development, and fit for the club


Collaboration with Technical Staff and Leadership

  • Collaborate with the Chief Scout and Technical Director to ensure player suitability
  • Support strategic planning with insights into regional player markets
  • Present reports and scouting analysis to senior stakeholders


Professional Development and Continuous Learning

  • Participate in CPD activities as required by the Chief Scout
  • Remain current on league dynamics, scouting tools, and player trends
  • Fulfill other responsibilities as directed to meet departmental needs



Qualifications


Desirable:

  • Scouting certification (e.g. PFSA, UEFA Talent ID, or equivalent)
  • Coaching qualifications (UEFA License or equivalent)



Skills, Knowledge and Experience:


Essential:

  • Experience in scouting or recruitment for a professional football club or federation
  • Proven talent identification and player evaluation abilities
  • In-depth knowledge of tactical, technical, and physical attributes of elite players
  • Strong familiarity with the football landscape in your designated region
  • Ability to assess players in line with club philosophy
  • Skilled in both live and video scouting, with a structured reporting style
  • Understanding of recruitment and squad planning strategies
  • Proficient in scouting software and data tools
  • Strong networking and relationship-building skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Flexible to travel, including weekends and evenings
  • Valid driver's license



Desirable:

  • Leadership experience managing scouting teams
  • Confident presenting insights to executive leadership
  • Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East



Why Join Al-Qadsiah?


  • Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
  • Experience the Culture: Thrive in an environment that values quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony—this is the Qadsiah Way.



The Executives in Sport Group are retained on behalf of Al Qadsiah SC to make this appointment. All direct applications and CVs will be forwarded to The Executives in Sport Group.



If this role is of interest, then please press the apply button and include a copy of your CV.

title: Wind turbine bearing replacement (Visa needed) - Brasil
description:
Eosol Group is a leading company specializing in renewable energy solutions, dedicated to providing high-quality maintenance and repair services for wind turbines. Our commitment to excellence and sustainability allows us to provide exceptional services to our clients, ensuring optimal performance and longevity of their wind energy systems. As we expand our operations in Peru, we are seeking a skilled Blades Repair Technician to join our dynamic team.


Job Summary


We are looking for an experienced wind turbine bearing replacement to be part of our team in USA. You will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of wind turbine. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in blade repair, be detail-oriented, and possess a strong problem-solving ability. A valid visa is necessary for this role as it involves working on-site in USA.


Key Responsibilities


  • Inspection: Visual inspection of bearings for signs of wear, corrosion, cracks or any other damage.
  • Testing: Perform vibration tests, oil analysis and other techniques to assess the condition of the bearings.
  • Disassembly and assembly: Careful disassembly of damaged or worn bearings and assembly of new bearings, following the manufacturer's specifications and using specialized tools.
  • Alignment and balancing: Ensure that bearings are correctly aligned and balanced to avoid vibration and premature failure.
  • Lubrication: Application of the correct amount of lubricant to ensure smooth operation and prevent wear.
  • Predictive maintenance: Implementation of predictive maintenance programs to monitor bearing condition and anticipate potential failures.
  • Repair: Repair of bearing-related components such as shafts, bearing housings and seals, if necessary.


Qualifications


  • Minimum 1 year experience.
  • Current GWO courses.
  • Knowledge in wind turbine bearing replacement.
  • Change of residence.


What We Offer


  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing field with a focus on sustainability.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Professional development and training opportunities.
  • The chance to be part of a company that values innovation and excellence in renewable energy solutions.

Responsabilidades

  • Conferência de recebimento de materiais;
  • Apoio na organização do almoxarifado técnico.


Requisitos

  • Formação técnica em Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada com software CAD para projetos elétricos (ex: SolidWorks Electrical, EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical).
  • Capacidade de desenvolver documentação técnica clara e organizada para montagem e operação.

  • Experiência em ambiente de produção, montagem ou campo, com foco em integração de sistemas elétricos.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência com SolidWorks Electrical e SolidWorks Mecânico 3D .

  • Vivência em sistemas embarcados, marítimos ou robóticos.
  • Experiência com ERP e processos de compras técnicas.


O Que Oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos inovadores e de alto impacto na indústria marítima e robótica.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, dinâmico e em constante evolução tecnológica.

  • Salário e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.

Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo! ⚡⚓

title: Data Engineer - Remote
description:
Recognized as the leading software development company in the Americas, our client offers 100% remote modality and an excellent work environment in which employees can thrive, and work in multicultural teams, with flexible schedules and endless growth opportunities.


About the Role:

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems.


What You’ll Do:

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating Tableau datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders on the finished product.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Tableau; develop reports according to analyst-defined specifications

- Conduct technical training.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

- Maintain and process SQL Server SPs and queries.


You Must Have:


- At least 3 years of experience working as a Data Engineer.

- An understanding of Tableau administration, licensing, security, and deployment, and at least 1 year of previous work experience using Tableau.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- 100% remote work.

- Flexible hours - make your own schedule!

- Diverse and multicultural work environment.

- Paid parental leave, vacation & holidays.

- Hardware setup for you to work from home.

- Excellent compensation — well above the market average.

- Extensive opportunities for growth and professional development thanks to our mentoring system.


Enjoy the opportunity to have a dynamic lifestyle, better health, and wellness. Find renewed passion in your job, improve your productivity, and benefit from attractive growth opportunities for your career.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior System Engineer - Computing Technology
description:
Senior Systems Engineer, Core 42, Abu Dhabi - UAE


Please note this position requires relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE.


About Us


Core42, a leader in AI-powered cloud and digital infrastructure, is driving transformative technology solutions globally. Leveraging advanced resources and partnerships, Core42 empowers clients to harness sovereign AI infrastructure, especially in sectors with stringent regulatory needs. With a mission to redefine digital transformation, we combine sovereign capabilities with scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure, positioning itself at the forefront of AI innovation in the Middle East and beyond.


The opportunity


The Senior Systems Engineer – Computing Technology engages in the design, leads implementation, and provides Level 3 expert support for large-scale private cloud computing infrastructure, with a specific emphasis on computing technologies including hardware layer, operating system, hypervisor, and orchestration services.


Your Key Responsibilities


  • Co-design, implement, and manage hybrid virtualization and containerized platforms based on OpenStack, VMware VCF and/or Red Hat OpenShift ensuring platform stability, performance and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams on technology stack component evaluation and selection ensuring solutions are designed following best practices and optimized from both functional and non-functional perspectives.
  • Conduct regular capacity planning exercises to anticipate and accommodate the growing demands on the virtualized environment, ensuring it meets current and future requirements.
  • Develop and implement plans to enhance the reliability of the computing infrastructure, addressing potential points of failure and ensuring high availability of services.
  • Explore, analyze, and implement performance optimization strategies for the cloud computing environment, ensuring optimal resource utilization and responsiveness.
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to conduct regular performance assessments and implement improvements based on findings.
  • Prepare and participate in complex changes to production environments supporting operational teams.
  • Develop auto-test and automation solutions for cloud platform using tools like Jenkins and Selenium along with other configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Provide L3 expert support including on-call shifts with focus on immediate incident management and resolutions, such as outages, breaches, and system failures.
  • Write and maintain relevant documentation ensuring completeness and quality.
  • Prepare and provide trainings for operational teams in the related technical domains.
  • Collaborate with security management teams to ensure that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats.
  • Work closely with process management and operational teams and contribute to process development standardizing collaboration framework and improving collaboration efficiency


What we're looking for


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or other relevant technology field.
  • 7+ years of experience and deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing private cloud stacks with the focus on compute and virtualization technologies.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with at least one of the following platforms/stacks: OpenStack, Apache CloudStack, VMware VCF and Red Hat OpenShift and related computing technologies such as x86 hardware, OS, KVM/ESXi and orchestration services.
  • Expert level in Linux and 5+ years of hands-on experience in Linux-based environments.
  • Profound understanding of hardware architecture and components (x86 and ARM, NUMA, types of memory and channels, types of NICs, etc.
  • Good understanding of network and storage types and architecture.
  • Good understanding of Cloud Native concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in managing large-scale public or private cloud environments and/or work in a cloud service provider environment is highly desirable.
  • Advanced level in programming and scripting using Python and/or Golang, bash.
  • Good knowledge in Data center network designs and related technologies (OSI model, TCP/IP stack, routing, VLAN/VxLAN, etc)
  • Understanding of storage types, architecture, and protocols such as object/block/file storages, NFS/SMB, iSCSI, FC, etc.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools like Zabbix or Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
  • Understanding of CI/CD principles, Infrastructure as Code (IaaC) approach and software defined infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience with database management and optimization for both SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra is highly desirable.
  • Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira, Redmine, ServiceNow etc.
  • Relevant certifications in Linux, virtualization and cloud computing are a plus.
  • Knowledge and experience working with GPU-hardware and AI hardware accelerators is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making.


What working at Core42 offers


With a diverse team of 1,100+ employees from 68 nationalities, we foster an inclusive, innovative and collaborative environment. At Core42, we foster a culture grounded in trust, accountability and high performance. We are united by our values: Grit , where we overcome challenges with resilience and determination, Passion , which drives us to pursue excellence in everything we do, and Impact , as we aim to inspire progress and create meaningful change. Our team members thrive in an environment where each person’s contributions propel us forward, and together, we commit to achieving extraordinary results.


  • Competitive Salary: We offer an attractive salary package based on your skills and experience
  • Yearly Bonus: In recognition of your contributions, you will receive a performance-based annual bonus
  • Exclusive Discount Cards: Access special benefits with Esaad and Fazaa cards, offering discounts across a wide range of services
  • Premium Family Insurance: We provide comprehensive health coverage, including dental, vision and life insurance, ensuring the well-being of you and your family
  • Learning & Development: We offer access to top-tier learning platforms to help you grow in your career. Learn at your own pace with unlimited access to premium courses.

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.


About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.


Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications : First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.
  • Planning & Coordination : Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.
  • Communication : Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.
  • Safety & Quality : Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.


What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

title: Hunter B2B de Publicidade
description:
Sobre a Orla Rio

Com mais de 300 quiosques espalhados pela orla carioca , transformamos a praia em um palco vivo de gastronomia, lazer, cultura, bem-estar e... publicidade com alma.

Aqui, ativamos marcas com o pé na areia e o coração no lifestyle .

Nosso negócio é conectar grandes ideias a momentos inesquecíveis — do nascer ao pôr do sol.


Missão do cargo:

Sua missão será abrir caminhos.

O Hunter será responsável por desbravar novos mercados , identificar oportunidades, construir relacionamentos estratégicos e posicionar a Orla Rio como a plataforma de mídia mais desejada do país para marcas que querem se conectar com o público de forma autêntica, criativa e memorável.

  • Mapear e prospectar novos anunciantes e agências nos segmentos mais estratégicos (moda, bebidas, turismo, entretenimento, tecnologia, saúde, esportes...).
  • Identificar oportunidades ligadas ao calendário cultural e turístico do Rio .
  • Apresentar soluções como ativações de marca, publicidade OOH, experiências proprietárias e naming rights .
  • Gerar reuniões para os closers.
  • Criar e adaptar propostas comerciais.
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais iniciais e propor soluções personalizadas com olhar consultivo .
  • Alimentar e gerenciar o CRM com disciplina, inteligência e visão de pipeline.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os hubs de publicidade e com a área de growth para sinergia nas entregas.
  • Representar a Orla Rio como embaixador da nossa plataforma no mercado anunciante .


Perfil ideal:

  • Hunter nato: tem brilho no olho por abrir negócios, sabe onde cutucar e não tem medo de porta fechada.
  • Pensamento consultivo: você não vende mídia — você cria soluções que fazem sentido para a marca.
  • Repertório criativo: acompanha campanhas, entende timing cultural, vive o mercado publicitário.
  • Comunicação afiada: sabe apresentar, encantar e convencer.
  • Relacionamento estratégico: tem (ou constrói) rede forte com agências, marcas e tomadores de decisão.
  • Mentalidade de crescimento: espírito de dono(a), foco em resultado e vontade de fazer acontecer.


Pré-requisitos:

  • Experiência anterior em vendas B2B — preferencialmente em publicidade, mídia OOH, ativações ou brand experience.
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências e das dinâmicas de marketing e trade marketing das grandes marcas.
  • Vivência em funções como SDR, pré-vendas, inside sales ou hunter.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Organização, foco, resiliência e autogestão.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM como RD Station , Ramper ou similares.
  • Capacidade de pensar como estrategista, agir como vendedor(a) e se portar como parceiro de negócios.


Diferenciais:

  • Ter atuado com projetos especiais, experiências de marca ou ativações em campo.
  • Conhecimento da cultura carioca, comportamento de consumo de praia e lifestyle local.
  • Portfólio de clientes relevantes ou histórico de contas de impacto.
  • Inglês fluente: leitura, escrita e conversação.


Remuneração:

Modalidade PJ - Remuneração a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial) + comissão.


Se você acredita que o melhor da vida acontece ao ar livre , sabe como contar boas histórias com marcas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está redesenhando o jeito de viver (e anunciar) no Rio , esse é o seu lugar.

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.


At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers.   • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.



What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

title: BMS Commissioning Engineer
description:
BMS Commissioning Engineer - UAE


Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.


Why Join Us?

As a Commissioning Engineer, you’ll lead the commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS) across key project sections. From planning resources to optimizing system performance, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring high-quality installations and efficient site execution.


At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.


Your Role

  • Conduct all BMS commissioning phases: Pre-functional, Functional, and Integrated Systems Testing
  • Perform software/hardware integration with third-party systems
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system defects, supporting other trades and contractors
  • Develop, test, and commission BMS control programs based on detailed Sequences of Operation
  • Oversee Site Acceptance Tests and demonstrate systems to consultants and clients
  • Fine-tune system parameters to meet design intent and maximize energy efficiency
  • Manage installation teams and day-to-day site activities, including labor, materials, and equipment
  • Coordinate with the commissioning manager and document all commissioning activities
  • Ensure all technical documentation, QA/QC protocols, and HSE compliance are maintained
  • Control drawing management and track updates for as-built submissions
  • Record team efficiencies and report delays, constraints, or deviations
  • Oversee handover documentation, including spares, warranty details, and compliance statements


What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Electrical Engineering (required)
  • Minimum 10 years of hands-on commissioning experience, especially in BMS and integrated systems
  • Strong leadership, decision-making, and communication abilities
  • Proven success handling teams, budgets, and project timelines
  • Ability to work under pressure with autonomy and precision
  • Familiar with project specifications, construction drawings, and commercial coordination


What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.


Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Site Manager
description:
Site Manager | UAE


Ready to build what others only imagine? As a Site Manager at ALEC, you’ll turn blueprints into landmarks, managing execution with precision, speed, and impact.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a Site Manager in ALEC Building, you will be responsible for overseeing all finishing aspects of construction projects including blockwork, POP work, plastering, painting, and carpentry, ensuring timely delivery within budget and to the highest quality standards.


Your Role

  • Develop and control site plans for finishing works, accurately calculating required human and material resources.
  • Create, implement, and enforce comprehensive Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) plans on site.
  • Lead and motivate construction teams, ensuring clear communication and high performance.
  • Collaborate with the Commercial Team to monitor and control construction costs, addressing any anomalies.
  • Establish and maintain a robust quality management system and control plan for finishing works.
  • Liaise with clients, authorities, consultants, and stakeholders to provide timely project updates.
  • Interpret and apply technical drawings, tender documents, and contract requirements effectively.
  • Monitor productivity and progress, ensuring accurate measurement and recording of works.
  • Manage testing of technical components, interpreting results and implementing corrective actions.
  • Plan and prepare for upcoming contracts, including tender revision, scheduling, and site setup.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (BEng, BTEC, ND) in Civil Construction or related field.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in construction, preferably in finishing works.
  • Strong leadership, planning, communication, and commercial acumen.
  • Proven ability to manage complex construction projects on time and within budget.
  • Sound knowledge of HSE standards and quality control procedures.


What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.


Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Estágio em Engenharia (Gestão de Energia)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Principais atividades:

  • Apoiar a gestão administrativa dos projetos da área;
  • Elaborar relatórios para acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Realizar a gestão de pedidos de faturas de energia;
  • Monitorar sistemas e apoiar nas rotinas operacionais;
  • Interagir com diferentes unidades e interfaces, mantendo boa comunicação e organização.


Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando a partir do 6º período dos cursos de Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia Mecatrônica ou Engenharia de Telecomunicações;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa comunicação;
  • Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido (3 dias presenciais por semana);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.


Benefícios

  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.
